menu.backrooms.title: The Backrooms: Found Footage
menu.backrooms.settings.title: SETTINGS
menu.backrooms.settings.smoothing.info: How much the view lags behind your mouse, like a heavy camcorder. OFF = no lag. The original feel was 88%.
menu.backrooms.settings.shake.info: The gentle wobble of a camera held in your hands, stronger when you run, and the shaky hands when something is close.
menu.backrooms.settings.tilt.info: How far the picture leans into turns and sideways steps.
menu.backrooms.settings.motion_blur.info: The smear when you turn quickly.
menu.backrooms.settings.wide_lens.info: A 20% wider view in the Backrooms, like a camcorder lens. OFF = your normal field of view.
menu.backrooms.settings.quality.info: For weaker computers. MEDIUM and LOW use fewer dynamic lamp lights, less glow around lamps and simpler pool reflections.
menu.backrooms.settings.stamina_bar.info: A thin, faint line above your hearts showing your sprint energy. It only appears while you run or catch your breath.
menu.backrooms.tagline.0: IF YOU'RE NOT CAREFUL AND YOU NOCLIP OUT OF REALITY...
menu.backrooms.tagline.2: DON'T TRUST EVERY ARROW ON THE WALLS.
menu.backrooms.tagline.4: YOU ARE NOT ALONE IN HERE.
menu.backrooms.tagline.6: IT ONLY KNOWS WHERE YOU ARE IF IT SEES YOU.
menu.backrooms.tagline.7: THE CARPET IS STILL DAMP. NOBODY KNOWS WHY.
menu.backrooms.note.1: If you are watching this, I'm still down here.
menu.backrooms.note.2: The lights hum. They never stop.
menu.backrooms.note.3: Don't run unless you have to. It hears you.
menu.backrooms.note.4: Some of the arrows on the walls lie.
menu.backrooms.note.5: The radios in the safe rooms still work.
menu.backrooms.note.6: Find the EXIT signs. Go down to get out.
menu.backrooms.notes.title: FIELD NOTES
menu.backrooms.notes.what.title: WHAT ARE THE BACKROOMS?
menu.backrooms.notes.what.0: Endless empty rooms behind reality: old yellow wallpaper, damp carpet and the buzz of fluorescent lights. Every floor is a different level, every level goes on forever, and you see all of it through the viewfinder of your camcorder.
menu.backrooms.notes.in.title: GETTING IN
menu.backrooms.notes.in.0: Reality has seams, and they're in the dark. Keep walking into a wall somewhere dark and enclosed. Stay alone in the dark too long. Film the dark with a camcorder (iron, a glass pane and redstone). Or just lie down in a bed. Suffocating inside a block still works too. Either way the picture breaks up, and when it settles you're somewhere else.
menu.backrooms.notes.goal.title: THE WAY OUT
menu.backrooms.notes.goal.0: The only way out is down. Find each level's exit (a stairwell, an EXIT door, a drain...) to go deeper, until the last one lets you walk back into the real world.
menu.backrooms.notes.goal.1: - Exits are a few hundred blocks apart. Arrows drawn on the walls point the way, but some of them lie.
menu.backrooms.notes.goal.2: - If you die down here you wake up back in the real world (or at your last checkpoint on that level).
menu.backrooms.notes.levels.title: THE LEVELS
menu.backrooms.notes.levels.0: - LEVEL 0, the Lobby: a thick-walled yellow maze. Look for the EXIT sign over a wooden door.
menu.backrooms.notes.levels.1: - LEVEL 1, the Habitable Zone: endless open parking halls of numbered pillars, puddles and dripping pipes. The signs point nowhere. Doors under green EXIT lights lead into tight corridors where nothing hunts you. A white stairwell leads down.
menu.backrooms.notes.levels.2: - LEVEL 2, the pipes: long, narrow maintenance corridors with long pitch-dark stretches. Find the emergency EXIT door.
menu.backrooms.notes.levels.3: - LEVEL 4, the Abandoned Office: endless empty offices, rain on the windows. Safe: no monsters. Water coolers and vending machines have Almond Water. Take an emergency stairwell down.
menu.backrooms.notes.levels.4: - THE POOLROOMS: white tiles and glowing water. No monsters. Swim into the drain in the middle of a deep pool. A rare sunlit archway in a wall is a shortcut straight to Level 39.
menu.backrooms.notes.levels.5: - LEVEL 37, Sublimity: the Poolrooms' drain brings you up in bright flooded halls of white tile. Your mind heals here. Dive down a deep pit to leave.
menu.backrooms.notes.levels.6: - LEVEL 7, Thalassophobia: Level 37's pits bring you into a small flooded room above an endless dark sea under a concrete ceiling. Drop through the hatch (the rope climbs back up). You can hold your breath far longer here. The exit is a wooden door in a stone platform on the sea floor, about 150 blocks west of the room, ringed by pillars and huge pipes. Something enormous lives in the water. It never comes close.
menu.backrooms.notes.levels.7: - LEVEL 39, Megalophobia: Level 7's door brings you up in flooded white marble tunnels under a foggy night town of light-blue houses, walled in by a colossal mill. Climb a shaft's rungs and push open the hatch to reach the town. Food you carry vanishes there. Punch through rotten house walls to find Almond Water. Walk into a glowing window of the mill and survive its grab to reach Level 94. A rare chairlift in Level 9's Crimson Field also leads here.
menu.backrooms.notes.monsters.title: THINGS DOWN HERE
menu.backrooms.notes.monsters.0: - THE BACTERIA (Level 0): only ever one, a tall black wire figure, and it keeps finding you. It only knows where you are if it sees you or hears you sprint. Break line of sight: it searches where it last saw you, then gives up.
menu.backrooms.notes.monsters.1: - WATCHERS (Level 9): huge floating eyes sweeping searchlights. If one stares at you and charges its beam, get out of sight or you turn to dust.
menu.backrooms.notes.monsters.2: - THE OBSERVER (Level 9): a tall dark figure standing where the light doesn't reach. Look straight at it and it's gone.
menu.backrooms.notes.monsters.3: - SMILERS (Levels 1 and 2 in blackouts, Level 1's dead zones, Level 9's dark streets, Level 94 at night): a glowing grin in the dark. Hold your flashlight on its face until it burns away; some take longer. Never let it reach you. They can't follow you into a safe room or a house.
menu.backrooms.notes.monsters.4: - WINDOWS (Level 39): the mill's ground-floor windows wake when you come close. Don't linger and don't stare. Walking into one is the way out, if you survive its grip.
menu.backrooms.notes.monsters.5: - LEVEL 39's OTHERS: Hounds growl before they charge (hold their gaze); most Facelings ignore you; Clumps hide in the tunnel drains (go quiet when knuckles crack); don't corner a Wretch; Skin-stealers stalk anyone alone.
menu.backrooms.notes.survival.title: STAYING ALIVE
menu.backrooms.notes.survival.0: - Sprinting uses energy (the thin faint line above your hearts while you run). Rest to refill it. You can't jump, except in water.
menu.backrooms.notes.survival.1: - Your camcorder battery lasts about 40 minutes. The flashlight (R) and NightShot infrared (N) drain it faster. Right-click a Camcorder Battery to swap in a fresh one.
menu.backrooms.notes.survival.2: - Press H to show the camcorder REC overlay.
menu.backrooms.notes.survival.3: - Right-click Wooden Crates, Backpacks and Supply Lockers for food, Almond Water, pills, bandages and batteries.
menu.backrooms.notes.survival.4: - Your heart rate (top right) is your sanity. It drains in the dark, when you're alone and when you see monsters. Almond Water and Calm Pills bring it back. When it's low you see and hear things. None of it is real.
menu.backrooms.notes.survival.5: - Safe rooms (a green SAFE plaque over the door) keep monsters away and calm you down fast.
menu.backrooms.notes.survival.6: - Right-click the field radio in a safe room to save a checkpoint: if you die on that level, you wake up next to it.
menu.backrooms.notes.multiplayer.title: PLAYING WITH FRIENDS
menu.backrooms.notes.multiplayer.0: Everyone needs the same mod jar. Stay together: being alone drains your sanity, and standing next to a friend in the light calms you down.

message.backrooms.level9.field: The air turns ice cold. Grass to the horizon, and a red glow far away.
message.backrooms.level9.home: The grass gives way to the sidewalk. The suburb again.
message.backrooms.level9.foxhole: The hatch drops you into a narrow shaft... and pipes.

message.backrooms.office_fridge.empty: Nothing left but somebody's old lunch.
message.backrooms.l2.hot_zone: The air is scorching. The machines are deafening.
message.backrooms.l2.warm_door: The air here is warm. The door is warm to the touch.
message.backrooms.l2.logbook.0: SHIFT LOG, PUMP ROOM 2-B. 06:00 relieved nights. P-1 running hot again, 9 bar on the discharge. Bled the return. The knocking in the header stopped at 06:40. Started again when I sat down.
message.backrooms.l2.logbook.1: SHIFT LOG. Valve gallery walked and checked, every valve as tagged. Checked again at 14:10. Every one was shut. I didn't shut them. Nobody else is down here. Opened them all and re-tagged. -R.
message.backrooms.l2.logbook.2: SHIFT LOG. Section numbers wrong past the bulkhead. Passed B-14 three times walking east. Same dead bulb every time. Put a chalk cross under it. Passed my own cross twice more. Reported it on the line. Nobody answers on the line.
message.backrooms.l2.logbook.3: SHIFT LOG. The door by the riser is warm again. There is nothing behind it, we poured that wall ourselves. If it is warm, don't stand at it. If you hear it breathing, walk on.
message.backrooms.l2.logbook.4: SHIFT LOG. Kettle's on. Third shift without relief. The lamps on C circuit keep dropping out a section at a time. If anyone reads this: the jacket on the hook is mine. Leave it where it is.
message.backrooms.l2.logbook.5: SHIFT LOG. There's a gauge on the corridor wall that reads 7 when I stand in front of it. Read 11 when I ran. It isn't plumbed into anything. I took the glass off. The needle kept time with me.
message.backrooms.l2.logbook.6: SHIFT LOG. Sump 4 flooded overnight, pump dead, float switch stuck. Water's black and too warm. Something in the line upstream is pushing it back. Not going in again.
message.backrooms.l2.logbook.7: SHIFT LOG. Yellow line comes out of the south wall the wrong way up. Same tag, same paint, same dent. Went round to the other side to check. There is no other side.

subtitles.backrooms.level0_blackout_buzz: A light buzzes in the dark
subtitles.backrooms.level0_power_restore: Power hums back into the walls
message.backrooms.manila_note.0: "If you're reading this, you found it. Rest. Nothing in here ever changes, not even the dust. Take what you need from the cupboards and leave something if you can." (the volunteers)
message.backrooms.manila_note.1: "There's a wall a little way out from here that flickers like a dying tube. Don't stare at it, walk into it. You come out somewhere colder: concrete, parked cars, the smell of oil. Level 1. Better than here, for a while."
message.backrooms.manila_note.2: "Someone found me here. Actually FOUND me, after eleven days of walking past nobody. Out there you can stand right next to a person and never meet them. In here you can." (M.)
message.backrooms.manila_note.3: "Count the doors: one in every wall. They all open back onto the same yellow halls. I tried each one twice. The music never comes from behind any of them."
message.backrooms.manila_note.4: "Do NOT break the walls. K. did. Behind the wallpaper there was something black and smooth that hummed when he touched it, and then he wasn't there any more."
message.backrooms.manila_note.5: "Restocked: almond water, two bandages, batteries (dead?). If the cupboards are empty, someone needed it more than you. Write your name here: ________"
message.backrooms.manila_note.6: "GUESTBOOK. Thank you for resting here. Sign below."  M. (day 11)  /  Ana R.  /  K.  /  the man in the tie  /  Rosa & Jun  /  %s
message.backrooms.l0_hidden_note.0: "Made the bed again this morning. I don't sleep in it any more: if I sleep in it, this is home. The ticking started the day I found this room. I've looked everywhere. There is no clock."
message.backrooms.l0_hidden_note.1: "Sit in the chair. Face the corner. Count to a thousand. When you turn round it has been hours, and the ticking is a little closer. I've done it 41 times. Leave the chair facing the wall when you go."
message.backrooms.l0_hidden_note.2: "INVENTORY. Chairs: 14. Do not add chairs. Do not turn the chairs round. If you count more than 14, stop counting and leave."
message.backrooms.l0_hidden_note.3: "For whoever squeezes in after me: flares in the cabinet, chalk in the locker. Mark the walls. In the hall with the arches the pillars take your chalk with them when they move, so you'll know."
message.backrooms.l0_hidden_note.4: "The radio was playing when I climbed up. It's tuned to nothing and it still plays. Turn the dial and it remembers you: if something happens to you down there, you wake up here, under the tiles."
message.backrooms.l0_hidden_note.5: "From up here you can hear the whole floor hum. Some parts hum lower than the rest. Those are the parts that go dark. Stay where the hum is steady."
message.backrooms.l0_hidden_note.6: "They shut the doorway while I slept. Not bricked: just gone, wallpaper where it was. I drew it back on so I'd remember where. I sit and watch it in case it remembers too."
message.backrooms.l0_hidden_note.7: "The note in the cabinet is the true way out. I walked it twice and came back to write it down. The arrows on the walls lie in some districts. This doesn't."
message.backrooms.cubicles.work0: You could sit down for a while. There's work to do.
message.backrooms.cubicles.work2: Leaving now would be a waste. You're nearly done.

message.backrooms.arrive.level_39: A town in the fog, and the walls of something enormous all around it. Keep your voice down.
message.backrooms.level39.supplies_gone: Your food and almond water are gone. Your camera and batteries came through.
message.backrooms.l39_survey_note.0: M.E.G. SURVEY, LEVEL 39, TEAM 6. Day 2. Counted 41 houses on the north grid. All the same blue. Nobody has knocked a wall in yet. Nobody wants to be the one who makes the noise.
message.backrooms.l39_survey_note.1: Day 4. The windows on the east wall were brighter tonight. Ruiz swears one of them leaned toward him. We moved the tent.
message.backrooms.l39_survey_note.2: Day 5. Lost Hale down a hole by the poles. We heard him land in water, then heard him talking. It did not sound like Hale. Do not answer voices from the holes.
message.backrooms.l39_survey_note.3: Day 7. Supplies gone again overnight, the crates are empty and nobody opened them. Almond water in the third blue house past the tower, top shelf. Heading for the wall. If you read this, we went through a window.
message.backrooms.l39_camp.stash: Under the crate's false bottom, wrapped in an M.E.G. armband: two bottles of almond water. Someone meant to come back for these.
message.backrooms.l39_camp.empty: The false bottom is empty now.
message.backrooms.hydrolitis.stage1: You feel feverish. The water down there wasn't clean.
message.backrooms.hydrolitis.stage2: Your arms and legs feel heavy. The fever is getting worse.
message.backrooms.hydrolitis.stage3: Your stomach turns. Find almond water.
message.backrooms.hydrolitis.stage4: You can hear things that aren't there. Find almond water. Now.
message.backrooms.hydrolitis.cured: The almond water settles you. The fever breaks.

subtitles.backrooms.level39.wall_crack: A wall cracks and gives way
menu.backrooms.notes.goal.3: - Others came through before you. Some left notes in the crates and backpacks. And listen: an exit is never completely quiet.
menu.backrooms.notes.levels.8: - LEVEL 94, Motion: sunny toy-like hills, a little town and a castle on a glass mountain. Get indoors before night: Smilers come out. Houses with a dark doorway lead on to Level 490; flooded houses lead down to Level 7, and the light behind the castle's throne back to Level 1. A rare moulded-clay front door on a Level 9 house also opens onto Level 94.
menu.backrooms.notes.levels.9: - LEVEL 490, Penance: a dark doorway in Level 94 brings you out among crumbling ruins on floating islands over a sea of storm cloud, at night, in rain, among colossal chains hanging out of the storm. Whales sing somewhere in it. Hooded figures kneel and pray along the way and walk toward the spire; an old pilgrim by a fire will talk to you. About 400 blocks away, past a gatehouse, a dark Gothic spire hangs in four colossal chains, its windows lit. Climb it by the broken stair round the outside; in the half-way room the stair goes round and round: if nothing changes when you climb, go back down. From the top, cross to a chain, climb it and step off to leave, to Level 9. Fall anywhere else and you wake at the last radio you used.
message.backrooms.arrive.level_7: Water as far as the fog lets you see, under a concrete sky. Hold your breath. Don't think about what's under you.
note.backrooms.wanderer.0: If you're reading this: the way down is %1$s of here. %2$s. Don't stop to rest.
note.backrooms.wanderer.1: Counted my steps this time. It's %1$s, %2$s. Don't trust everything drawn on the walls.
note.backrooms.wanderer.2: Went %1$s. Heard it before I saw it. Listen for the sound that never moves.
note.backrooms.wanderer.3: M.E.G. field note: exit observed %1$s of this cache, %2$s. Restock if able.
note.backrooms.wanderer.4: Switch the camera to night mode. Someone painted the way, you can only see it on the tape. Mine pointed %1$s.
note.backrooms.wanderer.5: Exit: %1$s, %2$s. Writing it down so I don't forget again.
note.backrooms.wanderer.6: To whoever finds this crate: it's %1$s, %2$s. Leave something for the next one.
note.backrooms.wanderer.7: the sound gets louder going %1$s. %2$s. i can hear it now
note.backrooms.wanderer.8: Third time through. It's %1$s, %2$s. It was %1$s last time too. I think.
note.backrooms.wanderer.blank: The writing has run. You can't make any of it out.

message.backrooms.arrive.level_227: A forest under a white sky, on a branch of a tree too big to see. Don't step into the light.
message.backrooms.l227.unstable: The tree lurched, and you fell through it.
message.backrooms.l227.bubble: The bubble's surface closed over you.
message.backrooms.l227.dragged: Something under the ground pulled you through.
message.backrooms.l227.sun.2: I can see every branch. I can see you.
message.backrooms.l227.sun.4: You were always going to fall.
message.backrooms.l227.sun.5: The tree won't hold you for long.
message.backrooms.l227.sun.9: The bubbles are doors. I am the house.

menu.backrooms.notes.levels.10: - LEVEL 9, the Suburbs: an endless foggy suburb at midnight. Follow the green EXIT arrows to a highway underpass: the way back to reality.
message.backrooms.arrive.level_490: Ruins over the clouds, chains out of the storm. Don't look down.
message.backrooms.level490.fell: You fell. You wake where you last rested; the chains are still creaking.
subtitles.backrooms.level490.whale_far: Something vast calls, very far off
entity.backrooms.pilgrim.greet: Another one. Sit, if you like. The fire doesn't warm you, but it's something to look at.
entity.backrooms.pilgrim.line.0: The chains go down through the clouds. I dropped a stone once and listened. I'm still listening.
entity.backrooms.pilgrim.line.1: Nobody knows what the chains hold up. Or what they hold down.
entity.backrooms.pilgrim.line.2: The whales sing when they pass. Not to us. I don't think they know we're here.
entity.backrooms.pilgrim.line.3: There's one bigger than the rest. It stays near the top of the tower. It has been waiting a long time.
entity.backrooms.pilgrim.line.4: Don't stare down into the clouds for too long. Some of the shapes down there stare back.
entity.backrooms.pilgrim.line.5: The stair goes round the outside of the tower. Most of it is still there. Mind the gaps.
entity.backrooms.pilgrim.line.6: Halfway up there's a room, and a stair inside that goes round and round. If it starts to look the same, go back down.
entity.backrooms.pilgrim.line.7: The ones in hoods don't talk. I asked one where it was going. It just kept walking toward the tower.
entity.backrooms.pilgrim.line.8: I came here to climb it. That was... I don't know how long ago. The rain never stops, so you lose count.
entity.backrooms.pilgrim.line.9: At the very top there's a chain with an iron collar. Step off it. It's the only way down that isn't falling.
entity.backrooms.pilgrim.line.10: Go on, then. I'll keep the fire going for the next one.
message.backrooms.level490.caught: It has you. You wake in chains, far from the spire.
message.backrooms.level490.freed: The chains give. You are free: find your way back.
hud.backrooms.level490.struggle: Chained. Press %s to pull at the chains
